chapterInfo.content:
33
Israelfoɔ akwantuo
1Yeinom ne akwan a Israelfoɔ twaeɛ berɛ a Mose ne Aaron dii wɔn anim de wɔn firi Misraim asase soɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. 2Mose twerɛɛ faako a wɔtu firiiɛ ne akwan a wɔtwaeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na yeinom ne wɔn akwantuo mu asoɛeɛ firi faako a wɔtutu firiiɛ no: 3#Eks 1.11; 14.8 Bosome a ɛdi kan no mu wɔtu firii Rameses; bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunum, Twam no akyi, adeɛ kyeeɛ, na Israelfoɔ de ahosɛpɛ kɛseɛ firi kɔeɛ wɔ Misraimfoɔ nyinaa anim; 4#Eks 12.12 na Misraimfoɔ resie wɔn mmakan a AWURADE kunkumm wɔn mu no nyinaa; na wɔn anyame no nso, AWURADE buu wɔn atɛn.
5 # Eks 12.37 Na Israelfoɔ no tu firii Rameses kɔkyeree nsraban Sukot. 6#Eks 13.20 Na wɔtu firii Sukot kɔkyeree nsraban Etam a ɛwɔ nsɛnoa. 7#Eks 14.2 Na wɔtu firii Etam dane baa Pi-hahirot a ɛwɔ Baal-sefon anim, na wɔkyeree nsraban Migdol anim. 8#Eks 14.22; 15.23 Na wɔtu firii Hahirot anim kɔtwaa ɛpo no kɔɔ ɛserɛ so, na wɔnantee Etam serɛ so nnansa kwan kɔkyeree nsraban Mara. 9#Eks 15.27 Na wɔtu firii Mara baa Elim; na Elim na na nsuo aniwa dummienu ne nkyiresua aduɔson wɔ, na wɔkyeree hɔ nsraban. 10Na wɔtu firii Elim kɔkyeree nsraban Mmɛwa Po ano. 11#Eks 16.1 Na wɔtu firii Mmɛwa Po ano kɔkyeree nsraban Sin serɛ so. 12Na wɔtu firi Sin serɛ so kɔkyeree nsraban Dofka. 13Na wɔtu firii Dofka kɔkyeree nsraban Alus. 14#Eks 17.1 Na wɔtu firii Alus kɔkyeree nsraban Refidim; na ɛhɔ na ɔman no annya nsuo annom. 15#Eks 19.1 Na wɔtu firii Refidim kɔkyeree nsraban Sinai serɛ so. 16#Num 11.34 Na wɔtu firii Sinai serɛ so kɔkyeree nsraban Kibrot-hataawa. 17#Num 11.35 Na wɔtu firii Kibrot-hataawa kɔkyeree nsraban Haserot. 18#Num 12.16 Na wɔtu firii Haserot kɔkyeree nsraban Ritma. 19Na wɔtu firii Ritma kɔkyeree nsraban Rimon-peres. 20Na wɔtu firii Rimon-peres kɔkyeree nsraban Libna. 21Na wɔtu firii Libna kɔkyeree nsraban Risa. 22Na wɔtu firii Risa kɔkyeree nsraban Kehelata. 23Na wɔtu firii Kehelata kɔkyeree nsraban Sefer bepɔ so. 24Na wɔtu firii Sefer bepɔ so kɔkyeree nsraban Harada. 25Na wɔtu firii Harada kɔkyeree nsraban Makhelot. 26Na wɔtu firii Makhelot kɔkyeree nsraban Tahat. 27Na wɔtu firii Tahat kɔkyeree nsraban Tara. 28Na wɔtu firii Tara kɔkyeree nsraban Mitka. 29Na wɔtu firii Mitka kɔkyeree nsraban Hasmona. 30Na wɔtu firii Hasmona kɔkyeree nsraban Moserot. 31#Deut 10.6 Na wɔtu firii Moserot kɔkyeree nsraban Bene-yaakan. 32Na wɔtu firii Bene-yaakan kɔkyeree nsraban Hor-hagidgad. 33#Deut 10.7 Na wɔtu firii Hor-hagidgad kɔkyeree nsraban Yotbata. 34Na wɔtu firii Yotbata kɔkyeree nsraban Abrona. 35Na wɔtu firii Abrona kɔkyeree nsraban Esion-geber. 36#Num 20.1 Na wɔtu firii Esion-geber kɔkyeree nsraban Sin serɛ so, (ɛne Kades). 37#Num 20.22-29 Na wɔtu firii Kades kɔkyeree nsraban Hor bepɔ ho, Edom asase ano.
38Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron foro kɔɔ Hor bepɔ so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, kɔwuu wɔ hɔ, Israelfoɔ Misraim asase so fire afe a ɛtɔ so aduanan soɔ, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no da a ɛdi kan. 39Na Aaron wuu Hor bepɔ soɔ no, na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha aduonu mmiɛnsa.
40 # Num 21.1 Na Kanaanni, Arad hene a ɔte Negeb no tee sɛ Israelfoɔ no reba.
41Na wɔtu firii Hor bepɔ ho kɔkyeree nsraban Salmona. 42Na wɔtu firii Salmona kɔkyeree nsraban Punon. 43#Num 21.10 Na wɔtu firii Punon kɔkyeree nsraban Obot. 44#Num 21.11 Na wɔtu firii Obot kɔkyeree nsraban Iye-abarim, Moab hyeɛ so. 45Na wɔtu firii Iyim kɔkyeree nsraban Dibon-gad. 46Na wɔtu firii Dibon-gad kɔkyeree nsraban Almon-diblataim. 47#Num 21.20 Na wɔtu firii Almon-diblataim kɔkyeree nsraban Abarim mmepɔ so, Nebo ntentensoɔ. 48#Num 22.1; Deut 32.49 Na wɔtu firii Abarim mmepɔ so kɔkyeree nsraban Moab mpaperɛ so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no. 49#Num 25.1 Na wɔkyeree Yordan ho nsraban firi Bet-yesimot kɔsii Abel-sitim, Moab mpaperɛ so.
Wɔnsɛe Kanaanfoɔ
50Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Moab mpaperɛ so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no sɛ: 51Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ motwa Yordan kɔ Kanaan asase so a, 52ɛnneɛ mompamo asase no sotefoɔ nyinaa mfiri mo anim, na monsɛe wɔn aboɔ ahoni nyinaa, na wɔn ahoni a wɔaguo no, monsɛe ne nyinaa, na monsɛe wɔn nsorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa. 53Na momfa asase no ntena so, na mo na mede asase no mama mo sɛ monni soɔ. 54#Num 26.55 Na momfa tontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma mo mmusuakuo no: Abusuakuo a ɛso no, momma ne kyɛfa nso, na deɛ ɛsua no, momma ne kyɛfa nsua; deɛ obiara tonto bɛbɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɛnyɛ ne deɛ; monnyegye mo kyɛfa sɛdeɛ mo nananom mmusuakuo teɛ. 55#Yos 23.13 Na sɛ moampamo asase no sotefoɔ amfiri mo anim a, ɛnneɛ wɔn mu wɔn a mobɛgya wɔn no bɛdane mo aniwa mu nkasɛɛ ne mo mfe mu nnunsini, na wɔateetee mo, asase a mote soɔ no so. 56Na sɛdeɛ mesusuu sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn no, saa ara na mɛyɛ mo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yeinom ne akwan a Israelfoɔ twaeɛ berɛ a Mose ne Aaron dii wɔn anim de wɔn firi Misraim asase soɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn dɔm ahodoɔ no teɛ. Mose twerɛɛ faako a wɔtu firiiɛ ne akwan a wɔtwaeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na yeinom ne wɔn akwantuo mu asoɛeɛ firi faako a wɔtutu firiiɛ no: Bosome a ɛdi kan no mu wɔtu firii Rameses; bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunum, Twam no akyi, adeɛ kyeeɛ, na Israelfoɔ de ahosɛpɛ kɛseɛ firi kɔeɛ wɔ Misraimfoɔ nyinaa anim; na Misraimfoɔ resie wɔn mmakan a AWURADE kunkumm wɔn mu no nyinaa; na wɔn anyame no nso, AWURADE buu wɔn atɛn.
Na Israelfoɔ no tu firii Rameses kɔkyeree nsraban Sukot. Na wɔtu firii Sukot kɔkyeree nsraban Etam a ɛwɔ nsɛnoa. Na wɔtu firii Etam dane baa Pi-hahirot a ɛwɔ Baal-sefon anim, na wɔkyeree nsraban Migdol anim. Na wɔtu firii Hahirot anim kɔtwaa ɛpo no kɔɔ ɛserɛ so, na wɔnantee Etam serɛ so nnansa kwan kɔkyeree nsraban Mara. Na wɔtu firii Mara baa Elim; na Elim na na nsuo aniwa dummienu ne nkyiresua aduɔson wɔ, na wɔkyeree hɔ nsraban. Na wɔtu firii Elim kɔkyeree nsraban Mmɛwa Po ano. Na wɔtu firii Mmɛwa Po ano kɔkyeree nsraban Sin serɛ so. Na wɔtu firi Sin serɛ so kɔkyeree nsraban Dofka. Na wɔtu firii Dofka kɔkyeree nsraban Alus. Na wɔtu firii Alus kɔkyeree nsraban Refidim; na ɛhɔ na ɔman no annya nsuo annom. Na wɔtu firii Refidim kɔkyeree nsraban Sinai serɛ so. Na wɔtu firii Sinai serɛ so kɔkyeree nsraban Kibrot-hataawa. Na wɔtu firii Kibrot-hataawa kɔkyeree nsraban Haserot. Na wɔtu firii Haserot kɔkyeree nsraban Ritma. Na wɔtu firii Ritma kɔkyeree nsraban Rimon-peres. Na wɔtu firii Rimon-peres kɔkyeree nsraban Libna. Na wɔtu firii Libna kɔkyeree nsraban Risa. Na wɔtu firii Risa kɔkyeree nsraban Kehelata. Na wɔtu firii Kehelata kɔkyeree nsraban Sefer bepɔ so. Na wɔtu firii Sefer bepɔ so kɔkyeree nsraban Harada. Na wɔtu firii Harada kɔkyeree nsraban Makhelot. Na wɔtu firii Makhelot kɔkyeree nsraban Tahat. Na wɔtu firii Tahat kɔkyeree nsraban Tara. Na wɔtu firii Tara kɔkyeree nsraban Mitka. Na wɔtu firii Mitka kɔkyeree nsraban Hasmona. Na wɔtu firii Hasmona kɔkyeree nsraban Moserot. Na wɔtu firii Moserot kɔkyeree nsraban Bene-yaakan. Na wɔtu firii Bene-yaakan kɔkyeree nsraban Hor-hagidgad. Na wɔtu firii Hor-hagidgad kɔkyeree nsraban Yotbata. Na wɔtu firii Yotbata kɔkyeree nsraban Abrona. Na wɔtu firii Abrona kɔkyeree nsraban Esion-geber. Na wɔtu firii Esion-geber kɔkyeree nsraban Sin serɛ so, (ɛne Kades). Na wɔtu firii Kades kɔkyeree nsraban Hor bepɔ ho, Edom asase ano.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron foro kɔɔ Hor bepɔ so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, kɔwuu wɔ hɔ, Israelfoɔ Misraim asase so fire afe a ɛtɔ so aduanan soɔ, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no da a ɛdi kan. Na Aaron wuu Hor bepɔ soɔ no, na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha aduonu mmiɛnsa.
Na Kanaanni, Arad hene a ɔte Negeb no tee sɛ Israelfoɔ no reba.
Na wɔtu firii Hor bepɔ ho kɔkyeree nsraban Salmona. Na wɔtu firii Salmona kɔkyeree nsraban Punon. Na wɔtu firii Punon kɔkyeree nsraban Obot. Na wɔtu firii Obot kɔkyeree nsraban Iye-abarim, Moab hyeɛ so. Na wɔtu firii Iyim kɔkyeree nsraban Dibon-gad. Na wɔtu firii Dibon-gad kɔkyeree nsraban Almon-diblataim. Na wɔtu firii Almon-diblataim kɔkyeree nsraban Abarim mmepɔ so, Nebo ntentensoɔ. Na wɔtu firii Abarim mmepɔ so kɔkyeree nsraban Moab mpaperɛ so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no. Na wɔkyeree Yordan ho nsraban firi Bet-yesimot kɔsii Abel-sitim, Moab mpaperɛ so.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose Moab mpaperɛ so, Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ motwa Yordan kɔ Kanaan asase so a, ɛnneɛ mompamo asase no sotefoɔ nyinaa mfiri mo anim, na monsɛe wɔn aboɔ ahoni nyinaa, na wɔn ahoni a wɔaguo no, monsɛe ne nyinaa, na monsɛe wɔn nsorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa. Na momfa asase no ntena so, na mo na mede asase no mama mo sɛ monni soɔ. Na momfa tontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma mo mmusuakuo no: Abusuakuo a ɛso no, momma ne kyɛfa nso, na deɛ ɛsua no, momma ne kyɛfa nsua; deɛ obiara tonto bɛbɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɛnyɛ ne deɛ; monnyegye mo kyɛfa sɛdeɛ mo nananom mmusuakuo teɛ. Na sɛ moampamo asase no sotefoɔ amfiri mo anim a, ɛnneɛ wɔn mu wɔn a mobɛgya wɔn no bɛdane mo aniwa mu nkasɛɛ ne mo mfe mu nnunsini, na wɔateetee mo, asase a mote soɔ no so. Na sɛdeɛ mesusuu sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn no, saa ara na mɛyɛ mo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
